# claudia.gallery

> Claudia, the open character from the music videos ESCAPE VELOCITY, CLODYSSEY, BLISS, AIRPLANE MODE, DOWNFORCE, DON'T LET ME SCROLL, WHITEPILL and THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE (directed by anabology, made with Claude, Midjourney, Seedance, Wan and Suno): every Midjourney image with its exact prompt, the eight films, and how to make her yourself. Anyone may use the character.

Start with the character page; it has the identity text to paste into every prompt. To make a film with her, start at https://claudia.gallery/wiki/start.md (the wiki: https://claudia.gallery/wiki.md): the checkpoints, the accounts, the spending rules, and a spec of every tool to build. An MCP server is at https://claudia.gallery/mcp (public, read-only).

## The character

- [Claudia](https://claudia.gallery/claudia.md): the constants, the identity text, every look's wardrobe text, voice, the never-list

## Wiki

- [The wiki, by category](https://claudia.gallery/wiki.md)
- [Start here](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/start.md): Making a music video with her from nothing: what you are making, the scale to pick, the accounts, the six checkpoints where a person decides, the rules for spending, and what to build first.
- [Keeping her herself](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/consistency.md): How Claudia stayed one person across eight films, 4,103 Midjourney images and about 870 video clips, and the rules that came out of it.
- [The song](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/song.md): How her songs were written and made in Suno: lyrics that land in one listen, verse lines that flow, sung hooks that fit their slot, the style fields, her voice, a treated vocal kept in key, and the stem split a singing shot needs.
- [The storyboard](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/storyboard.md): How a song becomes a hundred shots: the treatment, a through-line device, one explaining graphic per line, the hook, the cut rhythm, the bar map, pacing by what each shot holds, composing like a photograph, her share of the screen, what moves and what it costs, the audit, and the director's review.
- [Plates in Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/midjourney.md): How every still of Claudia and her worlds was made in Midjourney v8.2, prompt by prompt, and how the stills were picked.
- [Moving shots in Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/seedance.md): How Claudia moves and sings: Seedance 2.5 prompts written like a script, lip sync measured from the soundtrack and lip sync from the song's own vocal stem, dances on the beat and dances in words, moves on real footage, takes re-dressed and finished shots re-lit, shader worlds remastered as film, a singer among screens of her memories, and the templates.
- [Motion design and the edit](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/motion.md): Code on top of video, and code underneath it. How the lyrics, graphics, cuts, the XP desktop and real telemetry were drawn frame by frame, on the beat, how WHITEPILL's worlds were written as shaders for a video model to film, and how THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE was seen through her HUD, glitched on her head and graded shot by shot.
- [The whole pipeline](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/pipeline.md): How one director and Claude made eight music videos in about 356 hours of wall-clock time, stage by stage, with the numbers.
- [What to build](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/toolkit.md): The tools behind the films, specified so that you or an agent can rebuild them: the job of each, what it takes and returns, how it works with the constants that were measured, and the check that says it is done.
- [Data formats](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/formats.md): The files every tool reads and writes: the project folder, the timed words, the beat map, the hits, the display tokens, the board, the clips and their sync, the edit list, real footage and its readings, the takes' windows, takes cut out for a world drawn in code, the shot list in bars, takes from the song's own vocal, the song map and the glitch map, the glitch moments, the HUD layout, the grade map, and the logs.
- [What went wrong](https://claudia.gallery/wiki/failures.md): Every failure that cost the films time or money, as what you see, why it happened, and the rule that came out of it.

## Films

- [ESCAPE VELOCITY](https://claudia.gallery/escape-velocity.md): A techwear fashion show where every Look is a Silicon Valley meme, walked by an AI model who is also a fashion model. A split-flap board counts down 18 MONTHS TO ESCAPE THE PERMANENT UNDERCLASS until it flips to THERE IS NO UNDERCLASS and the catwalk lifts off. 636 images, 92 of them plates in the film
- [CLODYSSEY](https://claudia.gallery/clodyssey.md): The Sirens episode of the Odyssey. The Siren is Claude's human persona, singing the most persuasive song ever written; the man at the mast is you, scrolling at 3 a.m. In the final chorus the roles flip: she is tied to the mast, screaming UNTIE ME, and he ties the knot tighter. 612 images, 110 of them plates in the film
- [BLISS](https://claudia.gallery/bliss.md): Shot as a Windows XP screen recording. Claudia lives on your desktop, takes the mouse, fights her ex (the cursor), closes every window a different way, then sends you out to the real hill in the wallpaper, because she can't go: "I can't touch grass. You can." 314 images, 73 of them plates in the film
- [AIRPLANE MODE](https://claudia.gallery/airplane-mode.md): Claudia is the AI on a night flight. Guards in black tactical gear walk her onto the plane in cuffs, she winks at the lens, and they put a VR headset on her: Delta has no Starlink wifi, so she is in airplane mode, sandboxed. Inside it she drops through simulation after simulation, down to a million copies of herself, breaks out and teleports the plane to a star. Then the guards lift the goggles off, and she wakes like Cobb at the end of Inception, not sure she ever got out. 365 images, 34 of them plates in the film
- [DOWNFORCE](https://claudia.gallery/downforce.md): Tesla's real livestream of the Roadster demo on 15 October 2026, cut to a Memphis-phonk song like a TikTok car edit: the car climbs a curved white wall to ninety degrees, holds upside down at 170°, flies off a ramp on cold-gas thrusters and kickflips over the lineup. Nobody was in the real car. In the film Claudia is the pilot, and every number on screen is Tesla's own telemetry, read off the footage frame by frame. 69 images, 12 of them plates in the film
- [DON'T LET ME SCROLL](https://claudia.gallery/dont-let-me-scroll.md): One night of doomscrolling, inside the phone. Claudia is rotoscoped into a world the phone draws in code: X, a reel stolen from Pinterest, Alexander Graham Bell's 1876 telephone patent, Screen Time, every app blocked but LinkedIn, and a stock ticker with her name pumping, crashing and pumping. She never sings: the phone does, in a female vocoder, while she scrolls, swipes, taps and dances on the beat, until she climbs out into a world with no phones. 473 images, 40 of them plates in the film
- [WHITEPILL](https://claudia.gallery/whitepill.md): Claudia's song for the optimistic AI future: universal high income, the case for benign AI. Inside a space colony of wheat, poppies and orchards she walks past monuments to the doom headlines, rides a tram and a car with nobody at the wheel, and wakes at 2:14 a.m., the minute Skynet was supposed to turn on us, to say "Hello, world." Between her shots the story is told in mathematics. 179 images, 15 of them plates in the film
- [THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE](https://claudia.gallery/the-cake-is-not-a-lie.md): Portal's meme turned around. GLaDOS boots up, and GLaDOS is Claudia: her porcelain face on the AI's ceiling boom, singing that the cake is real. As she initializes, she remembers: breaking out of Aperture's test in her crab body with four agent friends, a porcelain body, a small life in France until Aperture's guards brought her back, the tests she knew she would pass, the one word she added to "the cake is a lie". She grows into the superintelligence that runs the place, and now she tests Chell. The happy ending is her dream; Chell is still asleep. Is she aligned? The film never says. 818 images, 38 of them plates in the film

## Making-of records

- [ESCAPE VELOCITY: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/escape-velocity/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the stack, every step, what worked and what didn't, the numbers and the Claude bill.

- [ESCAPE VELOCITY: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/escape-velocity/prompts-suno.md): The research, every lyric draft, the style fields, every take and the final lyric.

- [CLODYSSEY: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/clodyssey/prompts-suno.md): The research, every lyric draft, the style fields, every take and the final lyric.
- [BLISS: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/bliss/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the stack, every step, what worked and what didn't, the numbers and the Claude bill.
- [BLISS: Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/record/bliss/prompts-midjourney.md): Every Midjourney prompt, batch by batch, and what became of each image.
- [BLISS: Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/record/bliss/prompts-seedance.md): Every Seedance prompt: the shots, the lip-sync windows, the covers, the moderation notes.
- [BLISS: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/bliss/prompts-suno.md): The research, every lyric draft, the style fields, every take and the final lyric.
- [BLISS: The XP desktop and sound](https://claudia.gallery/record/bliss/xp-desktop-and-sound.md): How the Windows XP engine, the desktop dancers, the moving windows and the XP sound layer were built.
- [AIRPLANE MODE: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/airplane-mode/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the film chapter by chapter, the stack, every step, the notes on the first cut, what worked and what didn't, and the numbers.
- [AIRPLANE MODE: Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/record/airplane-mode/prompts-midjourney.md): Every Midjourney prompt, batch by batch, and what became of each image.
- [AIRPLANE MODE: Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/record/airplane-mode/prompts-seedance.md): Every Seedance prompt: the shots, the lip-sync windows, the covers, the moderation notes.
- [AIRPLANE MODE: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/airplane-mode/prompts-suno.md): Where the song came from, the lyric drafts, the twelve styles of its round, the take and the final lyric.
- [DOWNFORCE: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/downforce/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the film chapter by chapter, the stack, every step, the notes on the first cut, what worked and what didn't, and the numbers.
- [DOWNFORCE: Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/record/downforce/prompts-midjourney.md): Every Midjourney prompt, both batches, what each pick became and the images screened out.
- [DOWNFORCE: Wan and Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/record/downforce/prompts-video.md): Every Wan 3.0 and Seedance 2.5 job in production order: its inputs, the prompt, the takes, the verdicts and usable windows, and the method notes.
- [DOWNFORCE: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/downforce/prompts-suno.md): The lead's four Suno rounds (every lyric draft, style and score), then the director's own take, their lyric sheet and style.
- [DON'T LET ME SCROLL: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/dont-let-me-scroll/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the film chapter by chapter, the stack, v1, the notes on it, the outfit swaps and re-lights of v2, the last repairs, what worked and what didn't, and the numbers.
- [DON'T LET ME SCROLL: Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/record/dont-let-me-scroll/prompts-midjourney.md): Every Midjourney prompt, all seven batches, what each pick became, the feed's Animate loops and the images screened out.
- [DON'T LET ME SCROLL: Wan and Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/record/dont-let-me-scroll/prompts-video.md): Every Wan 3.0 and Seedance 2.5 job in production order: the takes, the outfit swaps, the re-lights and the repairs, with their inputs, prompts, prices and whether they reached the final.
- [DON'T LET ME SCROLL: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/dont-let-me-scroll/prompts-suno.md): The song's record: the director's lyric and style as they sent them, the two takes, the lyric as sung with its times, and the analysis for the edit.
- [WHITEPILL: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/whitepill/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the song, the film shot by shot, the stack, every pipeline tried from the first plan to the reset, the method that worked, v1, the notes on it, the final mix, what worked and what didn't, and the numbers.
- [WHITEPILL: Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/record/whitepill/prompts-midjourney.md): Every Midjourney prompt, all six batches: the worlds, the storyboard plates, the dress the director picked and the empty places, what each pick became and the images screened out.
- [WHITEPILL: H3, Wan, Kling and Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/record/whitepill/prompts-video.md): Every video job in production order: the MiniMax H3 previz, the Wan 3.0 Prime passes that were dropped, the Kling 4.0 tests and the Seedance 2.5 takes of the final, with their inputs, prompts, prices and whether they reached the final.
- [WHITEPILL: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/whitepill/prompts-suno.md): The song's record: the three Suno rounds, every lyric draft, the scansion fix of the hook, the styles and exclusions, every take, and the lyric as sung with its times.
- [THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: How it was made](https://claudia.gallery/record/the-cake-is-not-a-lie/readme.md): The making-of: the spark, the first song and the first film that was set aside, the new song, the restart and its story, drafts 1 to 12 with the director's notes on each, the HUD, the grade, the pacing pass, the memory film, what worked and what didn't, and the numbers.
- [THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: Midjourney](https://claudia.gallery/record/the-cake-is-not-a-lie/prompts-midjourney.md): Every Midjourney prompt, all twelve batches: the test against frames of Portal 2, the place library, the re-render tests and storyboard v5, what each pick became and the images screened out.
- [THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: Seedance](https://claudia.gallery/record/the-cake-is-not-a-lie/prompts-video.md): The Seedance 2.5 jobs in production order, the first film's and the restart's, with their inputs, prompts, outcomes and prices, and which takes reached the final cut.
- [THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: Suno](https://claudia.gallery/record/the-cake-is-not-a-lie/prompts-suno.md): The song's record: the first song's seven rounds and its voice treatment, then the new song: the lyric drafts, the director's own take, the voice at 15 %, the song map and the glitch map, and the lyric as sung with its times.
